summary_en: Tokyo Electron authorized a share buyback framework of up to 25 million shares (1.1% of outstanding shares) for a maximum total of 15 billion yen, to be executed through market purchases from November 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027, in line with mid-to-long-term growth investment and capital allocation strategy.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Setting of a Framework for Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Tokyo Electron's Board of Directors resolved on October 30, 2026, to set a framework for treasury stock acquisition under Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act, in accordance with the company's Articles of Incorporation. The authorization permits acquisition of up to 25 million ordinary shares, representing 1.1% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum aggregate purchase price of 150 billion yen.

The company intends to execute this buyback through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 1, 2026, and March 31, 2027. The framework is established to enable flexible capital allocation while maintaining mid-to-long-term growth investments and considering the company's current cash position. The company noted that, depending on market conditions, the acquisition may be executed in part or not at all.

As of September 30, 2026, Tokyo Electron held 70.3 million treasury shares against 2.27 billion shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock), reflecting a 5-for-1 stock split executed on October 1, 2026. The authorization does not include shares held in trust by the Board Incentive Plan (BIP) or Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) arrangements.
